## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is rebased on the latest `main`.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`refactor:` / `perf:` / `style:` prefix, single line, English, no co-author trailers).
- [ ] Code builds and tests pass locally (`⌘+U` in Xcode).
- [ ] No new compiler warnings introduced.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased] → Changed` if user-perceivable.
- [ ] No external behavior changes (or they are explicitly justified above).
